entities.summary: Daniel Miguel Colla is a retired volleyball player from Argentina who represented his native country in two Summer Olympics. After having finished in sixth place at the 1984 Summer Olympics in Los Angeles, he was a member of the men's national team that won the bronze medal four years later in Seoul.
